_note: Session 29: the moonshiners' holler's texts (encounters/Holler.js, combat/hollerTraps.js; DESIGN.md "Moonshiners' holler"). Every text is a draft for Aaron. The story they tell (my draft, Session 29): the Rigsbys ran a still up this holler for three generations. When the lights started coming down over the government land last spring, Clete Rigsby took them for the law (revenue men, the state, the feds: it was all one to him) and strung the holler shut: shotguns on stumps, cans on wire, snares, his daddy's bear traps. A man in a black suit came up it in the autumn, and didn't go back down. Then the portal went, and the family turned where they sat, round the still they never let go cold. traps: each kind's lines (combat/hollerTraps.js): hint (the first time Tom's near one), noCutters (the prompt at a line without the cutters), disarm (the X prompt, and what he finds), caught / free (a bear trap or a snare has him), hit (a stump gun's charge caught him).

shotgun.hint: Fishing line, shin high, right across the floor. It runs off to a stump with a shotgun wired down on it. Step over it, or cut it.
shotgun.noCutters: Fishing line, tied to a trigger. Jump it, or find something to cut it with

disarm.text: Line cut, slack in your hand. Two shells out of the gun.

shotgun.hit: The stump gun. You walked right into its line.

cans.hint: Tin cans hung on a wire across the floor. Brush it and every dead thing up this holler hears.
cans.noCutters: Tin cans on a wire. Jump it, or find something to cut it with

disarm.prompt: cut the wire, hold the cans still
disarm.text: Wire cut, the cans laid down quiet.

bear.hint: Leaves piled too neat, all the one colour. Nobody rakes a holler. Something's under there.

disarm.text: The jaws slam shut on the stick. A bear trap, an old one, chained to a stake.

bear.caught: Bear trap. Your leg's in it.
bear.wheel: A bear trap goes off under the quad and bites on nothing.

snare.hint: A sapling bent right over to the ground, pegged down. A loop of cord laid open in the leaves under it.

disarm.text: The sapling whips up empty, the noose swinging off the top of it.

snare.caught: The snare. It's got you by the ankle.
snare.wheel: A snare whips up past the wheel and hangs there, empty.

cutters.text: Wire cutters, red grips, out of the tackle box. On your belt now. They'll take a line clean.

sign: POSTED. NO TRESPASSING. Painted by hand, a long time ago, and painted over again since. Under it, newer, in a hurry: THIS MEANS YOU.

searches.prompt: search the man in the suit
searches.text: Black suit, a week in the leaves. Shot through the legs and the belly from the side: the stump gun. A pistol with every round still in it, a radio with the battery dead, a card with a number and no name. Whatever he came up here for, it wasn't the still.

A coffee can of cigarette ends. Pencil tally marks on the post, a column a night, and beside them in the same hand: LIGHTS AGAIN. 3. LOW OVER THE GOV LAND. THEYRE COMING. He sat up here every night waiting for the law. It wasn't the law.
Mason jars in crates, a dozen a crate, clear as spring water. The last run. Nobody's coming to buy it.
Sour mash, a crust on it, still working. Somebody fed these barrels after the lights went out. Somebody fed them after they were dead.

cabinet.prompt: take the gun out of the cabinet
cabinet.text: An auto shotgun, a drum on it, wrapped in an oiled rag at the back of the cabinet. Not a thing a family up a holler buys from a store. Somebody was expecting a war.

ammo.text: Shotgun shells, loose in old army cans. Enough to matter.

coil.prompt: lift the copper worm out of the flake stand

coilBlown: The flake stand's split down the middle. The worm's a twist of torn copper in the leaves. Nothing left of it worth carrying.

damper.done: The damper's shut. The fire drops to a red glow; the needle stops climbing.

relief.done: Steam screams out of the cap. The needle falls back out of the red.
relief.early: She bleeds, and climbs right back. The fire's still under her.

line.done: The line's off. The still ticks as it cools. Shut down.
line.early: The line shuts and the cap screams. Nowhere for it to go.

still.gauge: The gauge on the cap. The needle's in the red, and creeping.
still.watch: The needle's climbing. Nobody's been tending this fire for a long time, and it's still burning.
still.warn: The gauge is nearly over. Get away from it, or shut it down.
still.blown: The still goes up. Copper and boiling mash all over the yard. The worm went with it.
still.shut: The still's cold. The worm can come out now.

family.up: They're coming. The Rigsbys, what's left of them, from round the still.
family.trees: More of them, down off the ridge.
family.down: The holler's quiet. Just the branch, and the still ticking.

_beat: Session 29 (encounters/Holler.js): searches as the sawmill's (spot, hold, flag, prompt, busy, text; pistol: rounds found). valves: the still's three in order (damper, relief, line): prompt, busy, done; early: what happens when it's turned out of turn. The family wake when Tom comes into the yard, the cans ring, or a shot carries.
